    )


def test_invoice_total():

    if invoice.status != "issued":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}")

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Subscription


def current_period(sub: Subscription, at: datetime) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    """Return the [start, end) billing period of ``sub`` that contains ``at``."""
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    start = ensure_utc(sub.started_at)
    if at < start:
        raise BillingError("before_start", at.isoformat())
    length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)
    n = (at - start) // length
    period_start = start + n * length
    return period_start, period_start + length

from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.reporting import payments_between

UTC = timezone.utc
def p(i, dt): return Payment(i, "inv", Decimal("1.00"), created_at=dt)

start = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
end = datetime(2026, 1, 3, tzinfo=UTC)
before = p("before", datetime(2025,12,31,tzinfo=UTC))
at_start = p("at_start", start)
mid = p("mid", datetime(2026,1,2,tzinfo=UTC))
at_end = p("at_end", end)
none = p("none", None)
# timezone offset equivalent to mid
offset = p("offset", datetime(2026,1,2,1,tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=1))))
res = payments_between([at_end, mid, before, none, at_start, offset], start, end)
print([x.id for x in res])
assert [x.id for x in res] == ["at_start", "mid", "offset"]
print("edge cases OK")
EOF"}
